goal: Review why the post-acquisition Calculate Depreciation OK run with FADEP-273-OK did not produce a visible Fixed Asset G/L Journal line, and choose the next safe diagnostic step without repeating OK.
reviewQuestions: Did OK execute but produce no line because depreciation period, remaining amount or eligibility resulted in zero output?
Is the journal line hidden by journal template, batch, filter, personalization or page context?
Does Calculate Depreciation write to another journal target than the searched Fixed Asset G/L Journals context?
Should the next step be read-only FA Depreciation Book, FA Ledger Entries, journal batch inventory or setup/output-target diagnosis before any repeat?
acceptanceCriteria: FA-273 evidence is reviewed without opening Business Central.
The missing FADEP-273-OK journal line is classified as output, filter, eligibility, setup or automation uncertainty.
No repeat OK, Preview Posting or Post is unlocked without a documented next gate.
The next diagnostic step is specific and safer than repeating the batch job.
stopConditions: Any proposal repeats OK without explaining why FA-273 did not show a line.
Any proposal opens Preview Posting or Post before journal/output-target diagnosis.
Any proposal treats the missing journal line as successful depreciation evidence.
nextSafeAction: Read-only inspect FA-CNC-01/HGB depreciation start/end/year/value fields and Fixed Asset G/L Journal template/batch/output context; no OK, Preview Posting or Post.

result.summary: FA-274 classified FA-273 as OK executed once with no visible FADEP-273-OK journal output. Repeat OK, Preview Posting and Post remain locked; next step is read-only eligibility and journal output-target diagnosis.
